description: Composite figure made of four secondary-electron SEM micrographs arranged as a 2x2 grid of a hot-rolled Fe-8Mn-6Al-0.2C low-density steel solution treated at 700-1000 C for 1 h; the caption assigns (a) H70, (b) H80, (c) H90, (d) H100. Every panel carries a green 10 um scale bar plus a data bar reading Signal A = SE2, EHT = 15.00 kV, Date 12 Jun 2017, with individual values (a) Mag = 1.09 K X, WD = 8.7 mm; (b) Mag = 1.08 K X, WD = 9.1 mm; (c) Mag = 1.01 K X, WD = 9.1 mm; (d) Mag = 1.07 K X, WD = 8.9 mm. (a) H70 shows large light-grey regions labelled d-F, and a darker region in which arrows mark M5C2-carbide and martensite labelled M, whose area is enclosed by a dashed box. (b) H80 shows islands labelled A within abundant d-F and elongated needle/strip features marked a-F. (c) H90 shows fine blocky/equiaxed d-F particles together with a-F and A. (d) H100 shows blocky d-F, a-F, A and M; the dashed box at upper-left is magnified as an inset labelled M that displays a lath/needle morphology, and that inset has no separate scale bar. No phase fractions are printed on any micrograph; the citing text reports retained austenite of 12.2% (H70), 33.8% (H90) and 12.9% (H100). The four panels together document the change of d-ferrite from coarse strip-like to fine blocky morphology and the disappearance/return of martensite and M5C2-carbide with rising solution temperature.

observations.observation: The figure is a 2x2 grid of four SE-SEM micrographs, all acquired with Signal A = SE2 and EHT = 15.00 kV at 10 um scale-bar length, with magnification and working distance differing slightly between panels (1.09 K X / 8.7 mm; 1.08 K X / 9.1 mm; 1.01 K X / 9.1 mm; 1.07 K X / 8.9 mm).
In panel (a) the large light-grey constituent is labelled d-F, arrows label M5C2-carbide, and an arrow labelled M points into a dashed box in the lower-left of the image.
Panel (b) is labelled A, d-F and a-F only, and shows abundant elongated needle/strip second-phase features growing within a continuous matrix; no M5C2 label appears in this panel.
Panel (c) shows d-F as fine blocky/equiaxed particles rather than strips, together with a-F and A, consistent with a morphological change of the ferrite with increasing solution temperature.
Panel (d) contains an inset (dashed box at upper-left, arrowed) labelled M that shows a fine lath/needle structure interpreted as martensite; the inset has no scale bar of its own.
The caption assigns the four panels to samples H70, H80, H90 and H100, i.e. the steel solution treated at 700, 800, 900 and 1000 C.

The citing text states that for H70 nearly all the original austenite decomposed to martensite and spheroidal M5C2-carbide with a retained austenite volume fraction of 12.2%, and that M5C2-carbide is distributed both at ferrite grain boundaries and among martensite laths.
The citing text states that for H80 the M5C2-carbide disappeared and martensite reverse-transformed to austenite, with large amounts of strip ferrite termed a-ferrite observed.

The citing text states that for H90 the microstructure consisted mainly of a-ferrite, d-ferrite and austenite, that the d-ferrite morphology changed from strip shape to fine blocky shape, and that the austenite volume fraction increased to 33.8%.
The citing text states that for H100 martensite appeared again with only 12.9% austenite retained.

The citing text states that the phases were distinguished according to Vickers microhardness (Table 2) and that calculated austenite volume fractions are listed in Table 3; no such numbers are printed on the micrographs themselves.

subfigures.description: SE-SEM micrograph of H70 at Mag = 1.09 K X, WD = 8.7 mm, with a 10 um scale bar. Large light-grey areas are labelled d-F; black arrows label M5C2-carbide in the darker mid-region, and an 'M' arrow points to a dashed box in the lower-left marking martensite.

SE-SEM micrograph of H80 at Mag = 1.08 K X, WD = 9.1 mm, with a 10 um scale bar. Labelled features: A (austenite) as blocky islands, abundant d-F ground, and needle/strip-shaped a-F (alpha ferrite) indicated by arrows; no M5C2 label is present.

SE-SEM micrograph of H90 at Mag = 1.01 K X, WD = 9.1 mm, with a 10 um scale bar. Labelled features: fine blocky/equiaxed d-F particles, a-F and A distributed in a dense lath-like matrix; the d-ferrite appears as small isolated blocks rather than strips.

SE-SEM micrograph of H100 at Mag = 1.07 K X, WD = 8.9 mm, with a 10 um scale bar. Labelled features: blocky d-F, a-F and A. A dashed box at the upper-left is shown magnified as an inset labelled M displaying lath/needle-shaped martensite; the inset carries no separate scale bar or data bar.

unreadable_items: inset in panel (d): no scale bar or magnification is printed for the magnified martensite (M) box, so its magnification factor cannot be determined
no phase volume fractions or hardness values are printed on any panel; these come only from the citing text and Tables 2-3
